descriptionHtml:

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

As a Senior Software Developer on this high-impact team, you’ll collaborate across engineering, business, operations, and vendor channels to support critical infrastructure. Most product initiatives begin with us, as we enable reliable, scalable access to financial instrument data across Robinhood! Your work will help drive new feature rollouts and product expansions across multiple lines of business!

The WonderFi team including Coinsquare and Bitbuy, is now part of Robinhood and gives the company a direct path into the regulated Canadian crypto market through WonderFi’s licenses, platforms, and existing customer base. As part of the transition, Robinhood is gradually migrating eligible WonderFi customers onto the Robinhood Canada platform, with Bitbuy and Coinsquare accounts moving to read-only mode after migration while customers retain access to past transactions and tax documents for a period of time.

These roles are based in our Toronto, ON, Canadaoffice, with hybrid attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

What you’ll do
● Build scalable systems and backend components, balancing stability, performance, and maintainability
● Design, implement, test, and deploy production-ready features with high correctness and low-latency requirements
● Partner with frontend and data teams to refine APIs used by millions of customers
● Mentor junior developers and technically lead complex projects across teams
● Identify and implement improvements for system performance and team workflows

What you bring
● 5+ years of professional software development experience
● 3+ years designing and building large-scale, distributed, low-latency systems
● Proficiency in highly concurrent backend system development and intuitive API design
● Demonstrated ability to deliver long-term impact on systems or team-wide architecture
● Strong judgment and prioritization skills, with the ability to lead initiatives and mentor peers

About the team + role 

We’re thrilled to be expanding this year as Robinhood is hiring world-class engineering talent in Toronto. Our Hoodies in Canada will enable Robinhood to continue creating great financial products on our journey towards democratizing finance for all. 

Robinhood is a metrics driven company and data is foundational to all key decisions from growth strategy to product optimization to our day-to-day operations. We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to build and maintain foundational datasets that will allow us to reliably and efficiently power decision making at Robinhood. These datasets include application events, database snapshots, and the derived datasets that describe and track Robinhood's key metrics across all products. You’ll partner closely with engineers, data scientists and business teams to power analytics, experimentation, and machine learning use cases. We are a fast-paced team in a fast growing company and this is a unique opportunity to help lay the foundation for reliable, impactful, data-driven decisions across the company for years to come.

The role is located in the office location(s) listed on this job description which will align with our in-office working environment. Please connect with your recruiter for more information regarding our in-office philosophy and expectations.

What you’ll do 

  • Help define and build key datasets across all Robinhood product areas. Lead the evolution of these datasets as use cases grow.
  • Build scalable data pipelines using Python, Spark and Airflow to move data from different applications into our data lake.
  • Partner with upstream engineering teams to enhance data generation patterns.
  • Partner with data consumers across Robinhood to understand consumption patterns and design intuitive data models.
  • Ideate and contribute to shared data engineering tooling and standards.
  • Define and promote data engineering best practices across the company.

What you bring

  • CS background or any other relevant fields of study.
  • Strong product mindset
  • 4+ years of experience and a Bachelors degree or 2+ years and a Masters degree 
  • Experience building high-quality data solutions
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills.
  • Expertise building data pipelines using open source frameworks (Hadoop, Spark, etc)
  • Expertise in one or more programming languages (ideally Python).
  • Strong SQL (Presto, Spark SQL, etc) skills.
  • Familiarity with data visualization tools (Looker, Tableau, etc).
  • Great communication skills and ability to democratize data through actionable insights and solutions.

Bonus points

  • Passion for working and learning in a fast-growing company.

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career
  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, and equity ownership
  • Top tier benefits to fuel your work, including supplemental health insurance, ancillary insurance, and mental health support programs
  • Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible employer-paid benefits spending account expenses beyond traditional benefits such as wellness, childcare, learning, and more.
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, paid volunteer time off, parental leave, and more!
  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.
  • Monthly commuter stipend to help offset in-office commuting costs

title: Senior Product Designer, Core Experience
descriptionHtml:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. 

Most designers ship features. On the Core Experience team, you shape the foundation that millions of people already use every day — rethinking how the app's most important surfaces are structured, not just how they look. Robinhood keeps growing into new products and markets, and this role makes sure the core experience scales right alongside it — a big, visible opportunity that lives or dies on the details. We ship constantly — this team moves in weeks, not quarters.

The Core Experience team rebuilds the foundation of core Robinhood products, taking an experimentation-first approach on some of our highest-visibility, most-used surfaces. We move quickly, test broadly, and iterate with purpose. Our culture values confidence, flexibility, and the ability to turn ambiguity into momentum — and we partner closely with Product to balance great user experience with real business impact.

As a Product Designer on this team, you combine big-picture systems architecture with pixel-perfect craft. You'll own the core app shell — Home, Watchlists, Search, and beyond — rapidly generating and testing ideas across multiple product domains on surfaces that millions of users interact with every single day. You'll bring a strong point of view to your work and make the case for design decisions that involve real business trade-offs, including in conversations with executive leadership. The work is fast, visible, and consequential.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA or New York, NY office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you'll do

  • Set and hold the visual quality bar across the core app shell — including work you don't own directly — for surfaces millions of users see every day.
  • Rapidly generate and test a broad range of incremental changes across the mobile app using an experimentation-first approach (A/B testing, concept sprints, iteration at speed).
  • Design for the core app shell — Home, Watchlists, Search, and the surfaces that connect them — across multiple product domains.
  • Present design concepts directly to executive leadership with clarity and confidence, making the case for decisions that involve real business trade-offs.
  • Partner tightly with Product Managers and engineers to deliver great experiences in fast-moving environments — with the autonomy to define the problem, not just solve it.

What you bring

  • Proven experience designing for consumer mobile applications on high-visibility surfaces, with a strong sense of how product structure and navigation hold up at scale.
  • A portfolio that demonstrates exceptional visual craft and execution, from an in-house or agency background.
  • Real experience with experimentation methodologies — A/B testing, rapid concept generation, iterating based on data.
  • Confidence in your design decisions and the ability to navigate shifting requirements, advocate for your choices, and adapt without losing quality.
  • A collaborative approach to cross-functional relationships and genuine curiosity about emerging technologies, including AI tools in the design process.

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career
  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching
  • Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents
  • Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds.
  • Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not.
  • Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more
  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

  • Experience managing blockchain nodes in production.

  • Hands-on experience with Ansible, Terraform, or similar configuration management and Infrastructure as Code tooling.

  • Experience running containerized workloads on Kubernetes and Docker.

  • A strong security focus — you've worked on systems where key management and access control are critical.

  • Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, or an equivalent monitoring stack.

Bonus points

  • Experience integrating with third-party custodians like BitGo or Fireblocks — this is a key differentiator for this role.

descriptionHtml:
Join us in building the future of finance.

The Data Platform organization builds and operates the systems that power how data is stored, moved, and consumed across Robinhood. This organization spans three core pillars: Storage (Postgres, DynamoDB, and caching systems), Streaming (real-time event infrastructure), and Data Lake (ingestion and compute systems built on Delta Lake). Together, these platforms support transactional workloads, real-time data processing, and large-scale analytics that are critical to Robinhood’s products and operations. The team owns the full lifecycle of data—from low-latency order path systems to near real-time and batch analytics—serving millions of users and internal teams across the company.

As a Senior Staff Software Engineer, you will serve as the technical lead across the Data Platform organization, shaping architecture and guiding execution across multiple teams. You’ll work on complex distributed systems challenges such as database sharding and proxy architectures, real-time streaming and CDC systems, and large-scale data ingestion and compute platforms. You’ll define and drive key technical bets, partner with engineering leaders to align platform capabilities with business needs, and lead 0→1 initiatives that introduce new capabilities across storage, streaming, and data systems. This is a rare opportunity to influence multiple critical systems at once while raising the technical bar across an entire organization!

The Storage Platform team builds and operates the platform that powers database access across Robinhood. We own relational (Postgres/Aurora), key-value (DynamoDB), and caching systems, along with the SDKs, control plane automation, and data plane services that enable safe and reliable access at scale. Our mission is to standardize and strengthen how services connect to storage, improve reliability and performance, and reduce operational overhead through automation. As the Deputy CCO, you will play a critical leadership role in the oversight, development, and execution of the firm’s compliance framework, acting as the ultimate subject matter expert on European operations compliance and regulatory reporting. You will provide strategic guidance on applicable regulations - including MiFID and MiCA - while ensuring our EU sanctions controls are robust and effective. What you’ll do

  • Drive the implementation and continuous enhancement of the firm's compliance framework, with particular focus on MiFID II and MiCA requirements across all 30 EEA markets where the firm operates.
  • Serve as the firm’s ultimate escalation point and subject matter expert for complex sanctions alerts, conducting deep-dive investigations into potential matches.
  • Own and execute the firm’s regulatory reporting obligations (e.g., transaction reporting). Serve as a key point of contact for external exams, regulatory inquiries, and internal audits.
  • Partner closely with legal, product, and engineering teams to ensure that new and existing products adhere to applicable regulatory requirements (including MiFID and MiCA).
  • Maintain and update the firm’s sanctions policies and procedures, ensuring strict alignment with evolving EU regulations (ESMA), local laws, and global corporate standards.
  • Conduct independent assurance testing on sanctions controls, screening lists, and onboarding flows, actively driving the remediation of any identified compliance gaps.
  • Manage asset freezing and mandatory reporting procedures, ensuring true matches are restricted and reported to applicable authorities strictly within statutory deadlines.
  • Provide oversight of screening engines and blockchain analytics tools, offering strategic advice and tuning recommendations to the First Line of Defense.
  • Monitor EU regulatory developments,, translating regional risks into actionable updates for the firm's screening logic.

What you bring

  • Strong working knowledge of MiFID (and emerging MiCA frameworks) supporting retail financial services and capital markets.
  • Proven experience navigating regulatory divergence between different global jurisdictions.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex compliance metrics, screening engine performance data, and key risk indicators.
  • Experience overseeing outsourced functions or services, holding global teams accountable to local EU service-level agreements.

  • Define and build frameworks to improve monitoring, alerting, and observability across hundreds of services and systems

  • Deliver key insights and executive-level reporting to enable better business decisions around service quality and reliability
  • Act as a force multiplier through mentoring, technical influence, and contributions to hiring and engineering culture

  • Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills, especially during high-severity incidents
  • Deep knowledge of systems reliability, observability frameworks, and fault-tolerant architecture design
  • Experience with multi-region or multi-cluster architectures, capacity planning, and failover strategies

About the team + role

Robinhood set out to open the financial system to the many, not the few. We've done it for tens of millions of people in the US—now we're taking it global. This is one of the most ambitious initiatives for the company, and you'd be sitting at the center of it.

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency—it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. As a Staff Product Manager on the international team, you'll manage global business lines, own end-to-end product experiences in new geos, and work with experts in data, design, engineering, marketing, operations, and research to bring ideas to life that will help us democratize the financial system.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA and New York, NY offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you'll do

The International PM team's goal is simple to say and hard to do: democratize finance globally. That means scaling our products to work across many regions and building market-specific experiences that serve customers where they are.

As a Staff PM on this team, you'll own an entire region and set the playbook for acquisition, growth, and revenue in that region. Additionally, you will:

  • Ship groundbreaking products into new regions, working shoulder-to-shoulder with global teams.
  • Bring together product development teams to craft and communicate a product vision and shared set of priorities that meet the most important needs of our customers.
  • Drive the roadmap—extending what exists and defining what's next, including entirely new products for local markets.
  • Develop strong, collaborative relationships across design, engineering, and operations at the team and organizational levels.
  • Partner with leaders in communications, compliance, content, customer experience, and marketing to ensure our vision, products, and progress are well understood.
  • Ensure parity of product lines across global markets.

What you bring

  • 6+ years of direct product management experience building high-quality consumer products and growth efforts
  • Ideally, past experience working on a global, consumer-facing product
  • Demonstrated history of using research, experimentation, and analytics to guide decision-making
  • Experience working with and coordinating across globally dispersed teams
  • Past experience working with engineering, design, research, legal, compliance, and marketing in previous roles
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Passion for financial products that improve people's financial lives
  • Motivation to be a self-starter
  • Open to travel
  • Willingness to work in Eastern Time (EST/EDT)

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career
  • Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, and equity ownership
  • Top-tier benefits to fuel your work, including supplemental health insurance, ancillary insurance, and mental health support programs
  • Lifestyle wallet—a highly flexible, employer-paid spending account for expenses beyond traditional benefits, such as wellness, childcare, learning, and more
  • Time off to recharge, including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, paid volunteer time off, parental leave, and more!

title: Senior Compensation Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. 

Robinhood is on a mission to democratize finance for all — lowering barriers and expanding access so everyone can participate in the markets. Since our 2015 launch we've grown into one of the fastest-scaling brokerages ever, and that growth depends on hiring and keeping exceptional people. The Compensation team designs the programs that help Robinhood attract, motivate, and keep that talent as the company scales.

As a Senior Compensation Analyst, you'll own compensation analytics and the systems behind our broad-based base pay and variable comp programs. You'll build the models that drive pay decisions, run the tooling and workflows the People and Recruiting teams depend on, and use automation and AI to improve operations and enhance user experience. You'll operate across analysis, systems, and program execution — and have real ownership from day one.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; or Chicago, IL office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

What you’ll do

  • Build and maintain compensation models. You'll develop scalable models that support market benchmarking, budget planning, scenario analysis, and data reconciliation, delivering data-driven insights that inform compensation strategy and business decisions.
  • Lead compensation analytics. You'll drive survey participation, job matching, market pricing, and trend analyses to evaluate pay competitiveness and inform salary structures, equity bands, and compensation recommendations across global markets.
  • Design and maintain reporting and trackers. You'll create and maintain compensation trackers, dashboards, and budgets, delivering accurate, timely reporting that stakeholders can rely on.
  • Administer broad-based compensation. You'll support annual merit, promotion, and variable/incentive compensation cycles end to end, including planning, modeling, award generation, payroll/equity reconciliation, and post-cycle analysis.
  • Build and improve compensation systems. You'll maintain and enhance the compensation tooling, job catalog, and databases used by the People and Recruiting teams, and design automations that reduce manual work and error.
  • Support M&A integration. You'll provide compensation analysis and support for mergers and acquisitions, including due diligence, harmonizing pay structures, and integrating acquired employees into Robinhood's programs.
  • Further AI and automation across the function. You'll use AI and modern tooling to enhance and streamline benchmarking, analysis, communications, and reporting, making processes faster and more accurate.
  • Partner cross-functionally. You'll work with People Partners, HRIS, Finance, and Legal on year-round initiatives and ad-hoc analyses, ensuring clean data flows and clear communication.

What you bring

  • 5+ years of compensation experience in a fast-paced, high-ambiguity environment (e.g., pricing new roles without an established benchmark)
  • Advanced Excel/Google Sheets modeling with large datasets, with an emphasis on dynamic, QA'd models
  • Demonstrated market pricing and benchmarking experience (e.g., Radford, Pave, Mercer), including building and maintaining salary structures and equity bands
  • Fluency with AI tools and a bias for automating analytical work
  • Experience administering broad-based and variable/incentive compensation
  • Clear communication — you turn complex analysis into actionable recommendations
  • Sharp attention to detail, sound judgment with sensitive data, and strong ownership
  • Experience with HRIS/compensation systems (e.g., Workday) a plus

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career.
  • Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching.
  • Best-in-class benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents.
  • Lifestyle wallet — a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more.
  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits.
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

title: Staff Data Scientist (People Analytics & Insights)
descriptionHtml:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

The Talent Management & Analytics team is scaling to its next major milestone—integrating advanced predictive insights and tactical AI into our workforce systems. Our mission is to build the data solutions that help the entire company recruit exceptional talent, design high-performing team structures, and put active organizational insights directly into the hands of everyone making team decisions. Operating at the intersection of data science, product development, and organizational psychology, we are transforming how Robinhood uses data to empower our workforce and anticipate organizational needs.

As a Staff Data Scientist, you will serve as the team's technical and strategic anchor, owning the vision, design, and delivery of the high-impact data products that our executives, people partners, and line managers rely on every day. Your focus will be entirely on solving meaningful organizational problems: understanding what enables exceptional talent to thrive, accelerating team performance, and designing proactive strategies that support long-term retention across Robinhood. This is a unique opportunity to apply state-of-the-art language models and predictive analytics to solve critical talent problems!

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA, Chicago, IL, and New York, NY offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. 

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do

  • Spearhead the next phase of talent intelligence: Take the team beyond descriptive reporting and build the predictive frameworks that show not just what is happening in our workforce, but what will happen next.
  • Architect a unified workforce data model: Pipeline data across disparate recruiting systems, performance cycles, surveys, and internal tools into a single, cohesive data model that maps the entire employee lifecycle; use AI-native workflows aggressively to parse unstructured text like exit notes and survey feedback at scale.
  • Define the metrics dictionary and semantic layer: Standardize how metrics like headcount, attrition, and workforce trends are measured across the company; build the semantic layers that keep this data consistent and trustworthy at scale.
  • Drive data access control and governance: Build the frameworks for role-based access controls and data masking so HR, Finance, and line managers have exactly the access they need without risking sensitive personnel data.
  • Redesign employee sentiment architecture: Replace traditional annual survey cycles with a continuous, always-on listening framework that captures real-time organizational health and highlights leading risk indicators.
  • Own product delivery: Act as the technical product owner for internal data interfaces—collaborating directly with Enterprise Engineering to ensure exceptional user utility, predictive accuracy, and data reliability.
  • Enforce rigorous statistical standards: Apply experimental design, A/B testing, and psychometric methodologies to ensure our predictive workforce models and survey frameworks are scientifically backed and statistically valid.

What you bring

  • 7+ years of data science experience, with advanced skills in Python, SQL, and direct experience with modern data infrastructure like Snowflake, BigQuery, or dbt.
  • Strong product focus and experience defining user requirements, collaborating with engineers, and taking internal data tools from conception to launch.
  • Deep understanding of statistics, experimental design, and psychometrics or survey methodology to design research-backed questions.
  • Direct experience integrating language models into data pipelines to automate text processing and summarization at scale.

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career.
  • Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching.
  • Best-in-class benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents.
  • Lifestyle wallet — a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more.
  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits.
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

We focus on protecting our customers and maintaining the trust of regulators and partners. We collaborate with security, engineering, and product teams to ensure our technology arrangements are resilient and secure. Our team values rigorous analysis, open communication, and proactive risk management! Together, we ensure that our digital asset and brokerage services scale safely.

As ICT Risk Oversight Lead, you will serve as a key representative of the second line of defense for cyber and technology risk, providing independent challenge and oversight across technology operations, major change initiatives, risk appetite monitoring, and cyber and IT governance. In this role, you will review whether the business is operating within our risk appetite, assess the effectiveness of technology-related controls, and support regulatory alignment. You will also help strengthen oversight of outsourced and intra-group technology and information security activities. This is an exciting opportunity to report directly to the Head of Risk & Authorized Manager and drive the safety of our Luxembourg operations!

In this role, you will review whether the business is operating within risk appetite, assess the effectiveness of technology-related controls, support regulatory alignment, and help strengthen oversight of outsourced and intra-group technology and information security activities.

This role is based in our Luxembourg office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. 

At Bitstamp by Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

  • Carry out risk assessments for new products and for existing systems, processes, and technology arrangements.
  • Act in a 2LOD capacity collaborating with the IT and Security organizations, including close partnership with CISO and other relevant stakeholders.
  • Enhance the risk appetite framework and KRIs for ICT risks, perform independent reviews, and provide independent challenge to 1LOD.
  • Report findings, risk themes, and regular updates through established governance cadences and management bodies.
  • Promote ICT risk awareness and help strengthen risk culture across the organization.
  • Champion the effective and secure use of AI to support automation, efficiency, and scalable risk management practices.

What you bring

  • Strong knowledge of relevant ICT and cyber regulatory requirements, including DORA, MiCA, EU AI Act, CSSF expectations, and related European frameworks.

descriptionHtml:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. The AI Platform & Agentic Apps team builds the agent platform behind every AI agent at Robinhood. Today it gives a growing number of engineers and employees an AI teammate that ships code, queries data, and runs operational workflows on their behalf. We're building toward the same platform powering the agents millions of customers interact with directly, in real time. These agents don't just answer questions — they're designed to take real action across carefully curated meta harnesses. This is agentic AI at real scale, in a regulated financial environment, and it will change how Robinhood works!

As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer on the AI Platform & Agentic Apps team, you will design and build the harness that every agent at Robinhood runs on. A critical part of the role is making those agents trustworthy at scale: trajectory-level evals that measure how an agent reasons and acts, and action guardrails — permission models, approval gates, and sandboxing — built as platform primitives that other teams adopt. You'll be a technical anchor on a growing, high-caliber team, collaborating with product, infrastructure, and fellow ML engineers to take ambitious ideas from zero to one and into production. You'll help define the team's technical direction, mentor engineers, and shape how Robinhood decides an agent is ready to ship. This role offers a rare combination of technical depth, platform-scale impact, and the satisfaction of building systems that genuinely don't exist anywhere else.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Design and build the core of Robinhood's agent harness — orchestration, tool integrations, context and memory management — so one platform can safely power both high-trust internal agents and tightly scoped customer-facing ones.
  • Ship agentic applications end to end on that harness, from an ambiguous problem to a production agent that takes real action on behalf of employees or customers, and feed what you learn back into the platform.
  • Build trajectory-level evaluation systems that score how an agent got to an answer, not just the answer — tool-call correctness, planning and recovery, multi-step task completion — backed by simulation environments and synthetic task generation.
  • Architect action guardrails as platform primitives: least-privilege tool scoping, permission models, human-approval gates for high-risk or irreversible actions, step and budget limits, sandboxing, and rollback.
  • Make evals and guardrails products other teams adopt — SDKs, CI regression gates on prompt, model, and tool changes, continuous red-teaming, and production tracing that closes the loop from real traffic back into eval sets and guardrail models.
  • Set the technical bar through architecture reviews, code reviews, and mentorship, and be the person who can make — and defend with data — the "don't ship" call.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 10+ years of experience as a Machine Learning Engineer or ML-focused software engineer, with strong Python and distributed-systems fundamentals and a track record of shipping LLM-powered systems to production at scale. A Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Hands-on experience building agentic systems end to end — tool use, orchestration, context management, multi-step planning — on top of frontier models, in production.
  • Deep expertise evaluating agents: you've built trajectory-level evals, tool-call scoring, and simulation environments, and you can articulate why final-answer accuracy is insufficient for systems that act.
  • Demonstrated expertise designing action-level guardrails — permission and tool-scoping models, approval gates, blast-radius controls, and sandboxing — for agents operating in systems where mistakes have consequences.
  • Rigor in evaluation methodology: golden datasets, rubric and LLM-as-judge grading and their failure modes, statistical significance with small N, offline-to-online metric correlation, and eval data versioning and contamination control.
  • Proven ability to build platforms, not just models: you've shipped eval, safety, or agent tooling that other engineering teams adopted, and you have the judgment to know when to build versus buy.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching
  • Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents

  • Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not.
  • Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more
  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

descriptionHtml:

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. 

Robinhood is seeking a Software Engineer to join the Enterprise Build team: the small, high-leverage team that turns the company's best AI-built prototypes into true enterprise-grade services. Robinhood has gone all-in on an AI-accelerated workforce: every week, Hoodies across Finance, HR, Legal, Compliance, and beyond use sanctioned AI tools to build working prototypes of the tools they wish they had. The best of those ideas deserve to become real software. That is this team's entire job, and yours. 

The team is built on the premise that AI multiplies what a senior engineer can own: agents do the first pass of assessment, porting, and scaffolding; you review, harden, and decide. The work is a distinctive loop.  A prototype earns real usage in our experimental sandbox and arrives through a single front door. You assess it, decide what survives, often the idea and the workflow, rarely the code, and rebuild it as an enterprise-grade, production-spec service that meets our full engineering standards: SSO, audit logging, secrets management, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and security review, baked in from the first commit. While you build, you work directly with business partners, the forward-deployed pattern, pointed inward. Robinhood operates in a heavily regulated industry. Building fast here means building safely, and this team exists to help make sure those aren't in tension.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

What You'll Do

  • Assess vibe-coded prototypes from across the company and make the technical call: harden, rebuild, or redirect, then own the outcome end-to-end.
  • Design, build, and ship services on Robinhood's enterprise platforms, meeting the company's full standards for secure, reliable enterprise software.
  • Build AI-natively: drive agents through first-pass assessment, porting, and test scaffolding, and ship MCP servers, sub-agents, and agent skills as production artifacts where the solution calls for them.
  • Work directly with sponsoring business units (Finance, HR, Legal, Compliance) during each build, translating real workflows into software people actually adopt.
  • Deliver clean operational handoffs as part of your definition of done: runbooks, evals, and dashboards.
  • Establish the paved patterns with the Enterprise Platforms team: when you solve the same problem twice, make it a platform capability the third time.
  • Raise the bar on AI-era engineering quality, including rigorous, teaching-quality review of AI-generated code, your own and others'.

  • HTTP/2 and gRPC wire-level knowledge — connection management, flow control, stream multiplexing, and observability
  • Terraform at architectural scale — module design patterns, provider internals, remote state management, and multi-region provisioning

The team supports a rapidly evolving business, including cryptocurrency, brokerage, and money movement activities, while maintaining compliance with applicable U.S. and international sanctions requirements.

As a Sanctions Crypto Investigator you will be responsible for investigating potential sanctions exposure associated with cryptocurrency transactions, digital asset wallets, and customer activity. You will leverage blockchain analytics, investigative tools, and sound risk-based judgment to identify potential sanctions violations, assess complex transaction activity, and document defensible investigative conclusions.

  • Leverage blockchain analytics tools, including TRM Labs or similar platforms, to evaluate direct and indirect sanctions exposure, trace transaction activity, and identify potential sanctions evasion typologies.
  • Review and disposition potential matches against OFAC and other applicable sanctions lists, ensuring timely, accurate, and well-documented investigative decisions.
  • Identify and escalate potential sanctions violations, including transactions or assets that may require blocking, rejecting, or additional regulatory review.
  • Prepare clear, concise, and comprehensive investigative narratives, supporting documentation, and escalation recommendations.
  • Monitor emerging cryptocurrency sanctions risks, regulatory developments, and illicit finance typologies to support ongoing risk identification and mitigation.
  • Partner with Compliance, Legal, Engineering, Product, and other FinCrimes teams to resolve complex investigations and enhance sanctions screening capabilities.
  • Identify opportunities to improve investigative workflows, screening effectiveness, operational efficiency, and automation.
  • Assist with regulatory examinations, internal and external audits, quality assurance reviews, and management reporting.
  • Maintain adherence to established procedures, regulatory requirements, and internal service-level expectations while managing investigative workloads.

What you bring

  • 3+ years of experience in financial crimes, sanctions investigations, AML compliance, or a related field within financial services, fintech, cryptocurrency, or another regulated environment.

  • Working knowledge of blockchain technology, digital asset transactions, wallet addresses, and cryptocurrency transaction flows.
  • Experience using blockchain analytics tools such as TRM Labs, Chainalysis, Elliptic, or comparable platforms.
  • Strong understanding of OFAC sanctions regulations, sanctions screening requirements, and common sanctions evasion methodologies.
  • Experience conducting complex investigations, evaluating potential true positive matches, and preparing clear, defensible investigative documentation.
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to assess complex information and make sound, risk-based decisions.

The Fraud Investigation team’s mission is to ensure Robinhood customers have swift identification and resolution of fraud-related issues. We do this by interacting with customers when their accounts encounter fraud, placing temporary restrictions on accounts if needed, investigating customer-surfaced and RH-identified fraud, communicating in a timely manner, and efficiently restoring and remediating accounts to their pre-fraud status. We train and employ skilled and knowledgeable investigators, deliver consistent and high-quality support, and minimize impact from fraud losses to protect our customers and our company's financial health.

As a Fraud Operations Intern, you will conduct an end-to-end fraud investigation of accounts that have any concerns of fraud, with the ultimate goal of protecting our customers and minimizing fraud exposures to the firm. As a Fraud Operations Intern you will be responsible for reviewing fraud alerts, determining fraud or no-fraud and help identify emerging fraud trends through data analysis. 

This role is based in our Denver, CO office with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. 

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

What you’ll do

  • Review and investigate suspected fraudulent alerts — both proactive and reactive — using multiple internal and external tools
  • Use data analysis techniques, critical thinking, and pattern detection to identify emerging fraud trends and detection methodologies

title: Director of Engineering, Brokerage Platform
descriptionHtml:
Join us in building the future of finance.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

The Brokerage Platform org is the backbone of everything Robinhood trades, clears, and settles. It is the underlying infrastructure that powers every equities trade, every options contract, every event contract, and every crypto transaction that moves through our platform — and it is the foundation on which Robinhood's most important business lines are built. The org spans four deeply interconnected teams: Market Data & Symbology (the real-time and reference data layer that the entire product experience depends on), Trading Platform (core order routing, execution management, and bulk order systems), Clearing (settlement, margin, security lending, cash sweep, and the full back-office operations stack), and Brokerage Infrastructure (the platform layer that enables every product team to move faster through abstractions, reliability investments, and next-generation stack modernization). This org operates 24 hours a day around critical market functions — from market open to trade settlement — and when things go wrong, it matters.

As the Director of Engineering, Brokerage Platform, you will lead one of Robinhood's largest and most consequential engineering organizations. You will own the technical strategy, people leadership, and delivery execution for a broad, high-stakes platform — partnering closely with a dedicated TPM and engaging deeply with trading, crypto, and active trader product teams who depend on your org every day. This is not a role for someone who manages from a distance. You will need the engineering depth to challenge technical bets, the platform mindset to drive the investments that move the business forward, and the leadership presence to build and retain a world-class team in a domain where the stakes are always high.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA office, with in-person attendance expected 5 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do

  • Own the full engineering strategy and delivery for Brokerage Platform — spanning Market Data & Symbology, Trading Platform, Clearing, and Brokerage Infrastructure — setting the technical direction and ensuring the org executes with reliability and conviction
  • Lead and develop a large, distributed engineering organization of senior and staff-level engineers and engineering managers — building the talent, culture, and bench strength the org needs to sustain high performance over time
  • Drive platform investments that have direct business impact — identifying the modernization, reliability, and scalability bets worth making, building the conviction behind them, and seeing them through to measurable outcomes
  • Partner tightly with your TPM counterpart to manage a high volume of incoming asks from trading, crypto, active trader, and event contracts product teams — prioritizing ruthlessly and protecting engineering capacity for the work that matters most
  • Own the reliability and operational health of systems that run continuously around market-critical functions — ensuring the org is prepared for high-severity incidents and has the processes and tooling to resolve them fast
  • Engage deeply with cross-functional leadership across Robinhood — representing Brokerage Platform's roadmap, dependencies, and capabilities to product, ops, and executive stakeholders
  • Champion platform modernization and technical debt reduction — driving initiatives like stack rewrites, sharding, multi-region scaling, and infrastructure abstractions that unlock velocity across the entire engineering org

What you bring

  • 15+ years of software engineering experience, with 6+ years in engineering leadership roles — including demonstrated experience as a Director or Senior Director managing large, multi-team engineering organizations
  • Deep platform engineering background — you've owned and driven the technical direction of foundational backend platforms at scale, not just product features built on top of them
  • (big plus, though not directly required) Experience at the intersection of financial services, trading, brokerage, or adjacent high-criticality domains is a strong plus — you don't need to know all four of our sub-domains, but depth in one or two (market data, clearing, order execution, or brokerage infrastructure) is a meaningful signal
  • A track record of driving platform modernization bets that delivered real business outcomes — you've made the case for a large technical investment, executed it, and pointed to the result
  • Comfort operating in a high-severity, always-on engineering environment — you've led teams through major incidents and built the systems and culture to minimize their recurrence
  • Strong background with distributed systems, backend services at scale, Go or Python, and cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred)
  • Background from high-performance engineering organizations in fintech, trading, crypto, or large-scale consumer platforms — companies similar to Robinhood, Coinbase, SoFi, Google, or similar environments where the platform was the business is a strong plus!

Leadership expectations

Our ambitious roadmap requires a great culture shaped by exceptional leaders. Here’s what we expect from them:

  • Drive high performance by setting clear, focused goals, giving real-time feedback, stretching top talent, and scaling impact through focus, innovation, and tech.
  • Hire and retain top talent by setting a high bar, hiring only those who raise it, investing in onboarding, and addressing talent issues quickly and fairly.
  • Create community by connecting work to purpose, removing friction while prioritizing safety, building trust and inclusion, and leading from the front with integrity.

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career.
  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching.
  • Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents.
  • Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds.
  • Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. 
  • Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more.
  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits.
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Prime
descriptionHtml:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

The Prime team's mission is to build Bitstamp's prime brokerage for institutional clients — the platform that lets hedge funds, market makers, and professional trading firms onboard, fund, trade, borrow against, and settle positions at scale. We build the systems that move real institutional money: cross-venue settlement, credit against collateral, matched-book lending, and the bridge that brings tokenized securities to our order book — together with the client- and ops-facing surfaces that make them usable, from institutional onboarding and account configuration to reporting and the backoffice tooling our operations run on every day. These are correctness-critical systems where a wrong answer can't be cheaply undone — getting them right is the whole job.

As a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer, you will own the design and end-to-end delivery of features across that whole surface — from the Prime backend services down to the frontend and backoffice screens that expose them. You'll lead other engineers through problems of high ambiguity, set the technical bar for how we build for failure and not just the happy path, and follow a problem across the full institutional lifecycle rather than stopping at a boundary. Flexibility is the job: some weeks that's a settlement edge case in the backend, others a client onboarding flow or an ops dashboard, and you're happy owning whichever the work needs.

This role is based in our London office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

Requires participation in an on-call rotation to support business needs.

What you’ll do

  • Lead the design and end-to-end delivery of features across the stack — from Prime backend services (settlement, on-exchange credit, lending, tokenized securities) through to the frontend and backoffice screens clients and ops teams rely on.

  • Own the client- and ops-facing journeys across the institutional lifecycle — onboarding, account configuration, reporting, and the tooling that lets operations run the business safely.

  • Author detailed designs and break work into reviewable steps, making failure states, invariants, and recovery explicit before you ship — on flows where a wrong answer moves real money.

  • Uplevel the team through design-focused code review and mentorship, and move fluidly between backend and frontend as the work demands rather than handing off at a boundary.

What you bring

  • A track record of independently delivering complex, high-ambiguity projects with long-term impact, operating them in production and owning every line you ship.

  • Strong full-stack range in production — a modern backend (we work primarily in Python/Django and Go) and a component-based frontend (we use Vue) — with the judgment to know where a given problem is best solved and a genuine willingness to own whatever the feature needs, wherever it lives in the stack.

  • Hands-on experience building financial systems — user balances, ledgers, risk engines, settlement, onboarding/KYC, or payments — where correctness is non-negotiable and mistakes are expensive.

  • Strong design judgment: you enumerate the failure paths, name your invariants, and can point at the constraint, test, or alert that enforces each one.

  • Excellent communication: you drive alignment across teams and stakeholders, give substantive design-level review feedback, and mentor engineers to raise the bar around you.

🎁 What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career and shape the future of global institutional finance

  • Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, and equity ownership

  • Top-tier health benefits to fuel your work, including 100% employer-paid private medical insurance for you and comprehensive coverage for dependents, alongside mental health and wellbeing support programs

  • Aviva Pension Scheme with highly competitive company matching to secure your future

  • Lifestyle Wallet: A highly flexible employer-paid benefits spending account to offset expenses like wellness, learning, childcare, and more

  • Access to the best AI tools on the market with continuous AI skill-building opportunities for all employees

  • Time to recharge: Generous paid time off, company holidays, sick time, parental leave, and paid volunteer time off

  • Exceptional office experience: Catered meals, fully stocked snacks, team social events, and modern workspaces in our London location

title: Senior Product Manager, Gold Growth
descriptionHtml:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Robinhood Gold is our premium membership and one of the most important businesses at Robinhood. For one monthly fee, Gold members unlock a bundle of benefits, including boosted APY on uninvested cash, an IRA match, lower margin rates, professional research, access to the Robinhood Gold Card, and more. The Gold Growth team is responsible for growing that membership: how customers discover Gold, why they start a trial, what convinces them to become paying members, and what keeps them subscribed. Because Gold touches nearly every product at Robinhood, we reach customers across the entire app, and our work directly drives subscription revenue and how much of their financial lives customers choose to bring to Robinhood.

As Senior Product Manager, Gold Growth, you will own key levers of the Gold growth funnel and be accountable for business outcomes, not just feature metrics. You will decide where to invest across acquisition, trial-to-paid conversion, engagement, and retention, make clear trade-offs between growth, member value, and unit economics, and partner closely with data science to run high-velocity experiments, and read results with rigor. You will work hand in hand with design to craft simple, compelling consumer experiences, and you will operate with a high degree of autonomy: taking ambiguous problems, forming a point of view, and driving them to launch with little day-to-day guidance.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA or New York, NY office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you'll do

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for Gold growth across the full member lifecycle, from discovery and trial to paid conversion, activation of benefits, and long-term retention.
  • Drive business impact end to end, including new member growth, trial-to-paid conversion, churn reduction, and member lifetime value. Tie every product bet to the outcomes that matter for the business, not just the next metric on a dashboard.
  • Build and run a high-velocity experimentation program with data science: generate hypotheses, size opportunities, design A/B tests, and turn results into decisions you scale or kill quickly.
  • Make hard trade-off decisions across growth, member experience, and economics (for example, offers and pricing versus long-term profitability), back them with clear reasoning and data, and bring stakeholders along with you.
  • Work hand in hand with design and engineering to build intuitive, persuasive consumer experiences, sweating the details of the entry points, paywalls, onboarding flows, copy, and UI that shape how millions of customers experience Gold.
  • Operate as the owner of your area: find the highest-leverage growth opportunities, write the plan, rally partners across engineering, design, marketing, finance, legal, and compliance, and ship with minimal oversight.

What you bring

  • You have 4+ years of product management experience, including at least 2 years building consumer-facing products where you owned the end-to-end UI/UX alongside design partners.
  • You have a track record of driving measurable business outcomes in a growth context (acquisition, paid conversion, retention, revenue, or unit economics) and can clearly explain how your product decisions moved them.
  • You have strong product judgment and are comfortable making trade-offs under ambiguity. You form opinionated recommendations, defend them with data, and change course when the evidence says so.
  • You are analytically fluent and have partnered closely with data scientists on experimentation, funnel analysis, opportunity sizing, and impact measurement. Comfort digging into the data yourself is a plus.
  • You hold a high bar for consumer craft. You care about the details of a great experience and can articulate why one design converts better than another.
  • You are a self-starter who executes independently, creates clarity for others, and needs little guidance to take a problem from idea to shipped product.

Robinhood is seeking a Manager to play a leadership role in its Accounts Payable function. This role includes end-to-end ownership of AP operations, with a mandate to advance process maturity, drive automation, and strengthen controls across a Procure-to-Pay (P2P) environment integrated with an Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system. The successful candidate will combine strong domain expertise with a strategic and tactical mindset, and will be responsible for developing a high-performing team.

This role is based in our  Chicago, IL, Menlo Park, CA, New York, NY office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

What you’ll do

  • Play a leadership role in end-to-end Accounts Payable operations, including daily payment processing, system implementation / upgrades, process improvement, and ongoing optimization across the P2P and ERP environment (Coupa, Oracle).
  • Oversee two-way and three-way PO matching, invoice exception resolution, and vendor discrepancy investigation, ensuring accuracy and timeliness of the invoice-to-pay cycle.
  • Identify and lead automation initiatives — including AI and robotics-enabled solutions — to improve efficiency and accuracy within AP workflows.
  • Design and implement logical, well-structured processes with clearly defined roles, responsibilities, and controls.
  • Establish and maintain performance metrics and reporting frameworks to support data-driven decision-making.
  • Independently research, analyze, and resolve non-routine issues, discrepancies, and policy interpretation questions.
  • Oversee specialized payment operations, including non-USD and manual payment processing, Sales & Use Tax and VAT/GST compliance, Form 1099 issuance, and AP-related Treasury support activities.
  • Manage corporate card, travel, and expense reimbursement programs in partnership with Brex, Ramp, and Navan, including policy compliance and reconciliation.
  • Partner with HR/People teams on vendor and payment data managed through Workday.
  • Build and maintain effective cross-functional relationships across Finance, Treasury, and business partners, exercising influence and credibility beyond direct authority.
  • Lead, mentor, and develop AP team members, tailoring management approach to individual skill levels and supporting career growth.
  • Uphold internal controls and approval protocols consistently, including in situations where deviation is requested by senior stakeholders, to safeguard against fraud risk.

What you bring

  • Minimum 7–8 years of core Accounts Payable experience in a comparable business environment, including a P2P system integrated with an ERP platform.
  • Hands-on experience with PO matching (2-way/3-way match), invoice exception handling, and vendor reconciliation.

This role will partner closely with Technical Accounting & Financial Reporting (TAFR), Corporate Development, and the RHV Private Markets Valuation Committee to ensure valuations are well-supported, defensible, and compliant with US GAAP (ASC 820, ASC 321/323) and SEC reporting requirements. This role reports into Technical Accounting & Financial Reporting (TAFR) leadership and works closely with the RHV Private Markets Valuation Committee.

What you’ll do

Financial Modeling & Valuation Analysis

  • Build and maintain complex financial models (DCF, comparable company/precedent transaction analyses, OPM/PWERM, Monte Carlo simulations) to support fair value measurements of private company investments and other illiquid holdings.
  • Perform quarterly and event-driven valuations for private equity/venture-style investments, including waterfall/allocation analyses across complex capital structures (preferred stock, SAFEs, convertible notes, warrants).
  • Develop and refine valuation methodologies in line with AICPA Private Equity and Venture Capital Valuation Guidelines.

Governance & Reporting

  • Collaborate with Corporate Development, Legal, and Investor Relations on new investment structuring, follow-on financings, and exit/liquidity events to assess valuation impacts.
  • Advise on the accounting and valuation implications of new or complex investment structures (e.g., tiered/contingent consideration, equity-linked instruments).

Process & Controls

  • Drive continuous improvement of valuation templates, market data inputs, and benchmarking practices.

What you bring

  • Demonstrated expertise in building and auditing complex financial models (DCF, comparable company analysis, option pricing models, waterfall/allocation models).
  • Strong working knowledge of US GAAP fair value measurement guidance (ASC 820) and its application to private investments.

We are dedicated to protecting people, assets, and the Robinhood brand while maintaining operational resilience across all environments.

We're looking for a Senior Physical Security Operations Manager to drive global security programming across multiple countries, time zones, and complex third-party vendor workforces. In this critical role, you'll take a hands-on approach to shape and implement security policies, manage our uniformed security officers and emergency response team members, manage event security strategy, handle budgets, conduct facility risk assessments, and lead training initiatives for Robinhood’s global Physical Security Operations team. You'll play a key part in helping Robinhood prevent, respond to, and recover from security incidents—protecting both our people and our spaces. In this role, you will report directly to the Director of Physical Security.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA office, with in-person attendance expected at least 5 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

What you’ll do

  • Manage daily operations for an expanding international and domestic contracted physical security officer and emergency response force
  • Draft, review, and put into effect policies for the safety and protection of our global operations
  • Develop, implement, and be responsible for formal training programs for security officer roles including, standard operating procedures, incident response protocols, communication plans, etc.
  • Work closely with team members across different areas to set up security protocols for domestic and international office expansions
  • Display unwavering dedication to upholding the highest ethical standards, demonstrating a track record in managing highly confidential and sensitive information
  • Develop and implement an event security program for large international marketing events/product launches and also manage internal employee events. Develop event security plan frameworks alongside key partners.
  • Be responsible for facility risk assessments and propose key risk-management actions
  • Coordinate efforts with cross-functional partners on projects including the response to security concerns

As Director of Brokerage Risk, you will partner closely with brokerage leadership and cross-functional risk teams to refine risk management capabilities, lead the team's Data Analytics and Solutions function to surface actionable risk insights across the enterprise, and play an influential role in proposing and implementing strategic risk initiatives.

This role is based in our Chicago, IL office with in-person attendance expected 5 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

  • Own and evolve the Risk Management Program documentation, establishing clear standards and frameworks that create demonstrable value across the broker dealer enterprise
  • Oversee risk assessment activities including RCSAs, new product reviews, and emerging risk identification, ensuring rigor, consistency, and regulatory alignment
  • Direct the aggregation and presentation of risk committee materials and executive management reporting, translating complex risk data into clear, actionable decision-support insights

What you bring

  • Active FINRA Series 24 License
  • 10+ years of experience in financial services, with comprehensive knowledge of broker dealer operations and regulatory requirements
  • Proven track record of leading and developing risk professionals (typically 5+ years of management experience) across enterprise, operational, technology, and/or financial risk disciplines
  • Deep expertise in risk management frameworks including RCSAs, risk committee governance, and regulatory examination readiness
  • Exceptional written communication skills with the ability to produce clear, concise, regulatory-grade documentation and executive-level reporting

  • Demonstrated curiosity and comfort engaging with AI tools and emerging technologies, with a forward-looking perspective on applying AI capabilities to enhance risk monitoring, reporting, and oversight workflows

Leadership expectations

Our ambitious roadmap requires a great culture shaped by exceptional leaders. Here’s what we expect from them:

  • Drive high performance by setting clear, focused goals, giving real-time feedback, stretching top talent, and scaling impact through focus, innovation, and tech.
  • Hire and retain top talent by setting a high bar, hiring only those who raise it, investing in onboarding, and addressing talent issues quickly and fairly.

  • Ship tailored financial products into the Canadian market working shoulder-to-shoulder with cross-functional teams.
  • Bring together product development teams to craft and communicate a Canada-focused product vision and set of priorities that address the specific financial needs of Canadian consumers.
  • Drive the roadmap—adapting existing trading features and building local tax-advantaged features and funding rails.

The Observability team's mission is to build and own Robinhood's full-stack observability platform — the foundation that keeps every product, service, and customer experience running reliably at scale. We design and operate the systems that give engineers deep visibility into how Robinhood's infrastructure behaves, ensuring that when something goes wrong, the right people know immediately and can act fast. Our work spans metrics, logs, distributed tracing, and alerting pipelines, and we partner closely with the Robinhood Command Center to ensure our observability systems meet or exceed 99.9% uptime. We believe in monitoring our own monitors — the observability infrastructure is a product, not just a tool.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Observability team, you will be the technical lead shaping the roadmap for how Robinhood observes itself at scale. You will own the observability control plane end-to-end, making architectural decisions that directly impact the reliability and operational health of Robinhood's entire product surface. You'll lead a team of six engineers, drive the strategy for cost-efficient telemetry ingestion, build in-house solutions where off-the-shelf tooling falls short, and integrate AI-driven approaches to accelerate progress toward full-stack observability. This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role where your technical decisions set the direction for the entire organization!

  • Own and evolve the observability control plane, including telemetry ingestion pipelines, cost management strategies, and the tooling that ensures observability components remain highly available.
  • Lead and collaborate with a team of six engineers to build scalable, self-service observability solutions that enable product and infrastructure teams to move faster with greater confidence.
  • Establish and maintain SLOs for observability systems that meet or exceed Robinhood's 99.9% uptime target, ensuring the observability platform is as reliable as the services it monitors.
  • Partner with the Robinhood Command Center and engineering teams across the organization to align on dependency mapping, incident response workflows, and observability standards.

  • Strong coding proficiency in one or more languages (Go, Python, or similar) with experience integrating observability agents, libraries, and instrumentation directly into production codebases.
