Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. 

TradePMR is Robinhood's custody and technology platform for registered investment advisors (RIAs). Our integration ecosystem spans core technology partners, specialized workflow and TAMP partners, and a broader network of consultants, recruiters, and capital providers. You'll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Legal and Compliance, Marketing, Business Development, and the tactical integrations team. It's a collaborative group focused on advisor success and on building partnerships that last!

The Senior Manager, Strategic Partnerships & Integrations owns TradePMR's external-facing relationships with technology partners and advisor firms across the integration ecosystem. The tactical integrations team handles vendor onboarding, data feeds, and technical implementation. You'll decide which partnerships matter most and who we should build them with. You'll advise enterprise RIAs and breakaway teams, host partner events, negotiate special agreements, and equip our sales teams with accurate partner collateral. You'll also bring partner and client insight into integration roadmap discussions, shaping priorities through influence and input rather than build ownership. This is a business and partnerships role, not a product or engineering role, and your impact will show up in the strength of our advisor and partner relationships!

This role is based in our Tampa, FL and Clearwater, FLoffice(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

What you’ll do

  • Serve as a direct advisor to enterprise RIAs and breakaway teams evaluating custody transitions and platform fit
  • Own and run Transition Sandbox walkthroughs, live demo environments for prospective and transitioning firms
  • Act as a trusted point of contact for advisor firms navigating the TradePMR integration ecosystem
  • Build and maintain the Partner Resource Hub, including custodial comparison sheets, integration guides, and platform one-pagers
  • Equip Practice Management and Sales with current, accurate partner and integration collateral, and keep internal teams informed of live and upcoming integrations
  • Own and execute the Center of Influence (COI) engagement cadence, including monthly strategy touchpoints, quarterly briefings, and virtual executive roundtables
  • Stand up and run the COI Advisory Council, spanning consulting, technology, M&A, and recruiting
  • Directly own relationships with core technology partners and specialized workflow and TAMP partners
  • Coordinate with Marketing and Business Development on adjacent COI relationships, such as transition consultants, M&A advisors, capital providers, breakaway recruiters, and compliance consultants
  • Plan and represent TradePMR at flagship partner events, and own regional VIP dinners and executive roundtables, including guest lists, briefing content, and follow-up
  • Negotiate custom commercial terms with strategic partners, such as portfolio-wide custodial fee schedules, custom API reporting SLAs, and enterprise onboarding SLAs
  • Partner with Legal, Compliance, and Finance on sign-off for non-standard agreements, using a template-first approach and escalating to custom terms only where justified
  • Surface partner and client integration requests and pain points into Product and Engineering prioritization discussions
  • Represent the external partner and advisor-firm perspective in integration roadmap planning, and work with the tactical integrations team so strategic priorities turn into executed integrations

What you bring

  • 7+ years in partnerships, business development, or strategic account management, ideally in wealthtech, fintech, or RIA custodial and technology services
  • Demonstrated experience managing external relationships with technology vendors and/or advisor or client firms in a regulated financial services environment
  • Comfort serving as a primary external face for the organization, including event hosting, executive-level relationship management, and negotiation
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working closely with Product, Engineering, Legal and Compliance, Marketing, and technical integrations teams
  • Familiarity with the RIA custodial technology landscape (portfolio management systems, CRM, TAMP, and financial planning tools) is a plus

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career.
  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching.
  • Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents.
  • Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds.
  • Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. 
  • Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more.
  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits.
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

  • Support enterprise LLM integrations, including Anthropic Claude and Google Gemini, helping monitor API usage, token consumption, performance, and reliability.

  • Working knowledge of Linux administration and experience writing scripts or automation using Python, Bash, or similar languages.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure management, configuration, or orchestration tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Chef, or Kubernetes.
  • Experience troubleshooting production systems, investigating technical issues, and working with monitoring or observability tools.

As a Senior Payroll Tax Specialist, you will report to the Sr. Manager, Global Payroll and serve as the internal subject matter expert and primary operational contact for our external providers. You will own payroll tax processing and reporting across US, Canadian, and global entities, keeping us compliant with local, state, federal, and international regulations. You will configure and test withholding tax setups in Workday, reconcile liabilities, and lead quarter-end, year-end, and audit readiness. An early focus will be resolving legacy tax account discrepancies and putting in place the reconciliation foundation we need to scale, so your work will shape how this function runs for years to come! You will also partner with teams across Finance, Engineering, and People to deliver accurate reporting and analysis.

This role is based in our Chicago, IL, Menlo Park, CA and New York, NY offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

  • Run payroll tax processing and reporting across weekly, bi-weekly, and international payroll cycles, including multi-state and internationally mobile employees, and support payroll transitions from M&A activity.
  • Verify accuracy after each payroll with parallel reconciliations, and reconcile payroll tax liabilities weekly across US, Canadian, and global entities, along with quarterly returns filed by third-party providers.
  • Resolve and permanently close out legacy tax discrepancies and historical imbalances, including GL payroll clearing account variances and unclaimed payroll check (escheatment) requirements.
  • Lead quarter-end and year-end execution, including W-2s, T4s, and global equivalents, plus corrections and amended returns (W-2C, Form 941-X), and prepare for payroll tax audits with the IRS, CRA, HMRC, and state and local authorities.
  • Manage agency notices and new tax account setups, act as the point of contact for third-party providers, and deliver reporting and liability analysis to Finance, Accounting, Corporate Tax, and People Operations.

What you bring

  • Hands-on experience configuring and maintaining payroll tax rules in an enterprise ERP (Workday Payroll preferred) and working with third-party tax filing providers such as ADP SmartCompliance.
  • Solid understanding of payroll tax reconciliation, including liability reconciliation, quarter-end and year-end filings, and corrections and amendments.
  • Advanced Excel skills for data analysis and reconciliations, plus comfort using AI tools to streamline reconciliations and filings.
  • An analytical approach to untangling ambiguous tax scenarios with limited guidance.

You will build the systems that size this fleet to demand: Aurora reader counts and writer sizes set from market hours, declared events, and live load instead of fixed schedules; databases, caches, and volumes rightsized to what they actually use; and S3 data kept in the right storage class, with lifecycle rules that keep growth in check. You will take each from recommendations the Storage team validates to automation that safely applies its own changes in production. This is a 0-to-1 build with measurable impact on reliability at market peaks and on the AWS bill.

This role is based in our Bellevue, WA office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do

  • Build forecast-driven capacity planning for the storage and database fleet, turning traffic history, load tests, and known events (market open, earnings, IPOs, promotions) into plans that scale up ahead and back down after, with an expiry on every temporary capacity hold
  • Design and build a capacity planner for Aurora that sets reader counts and writer instance sizes from demand and load signals (IOPS, CPU, connections, replica lag), replacing fixed scaling schedules
  • Rightsize databases, caches, and block storage (RDS, ElastiCache, DynamoDB, EBS) on instance size, provisioned IOPS and throughput, and idle capacity, and keep them right-sized as load changes
  • Own S3 efficiency at scale: storage class and Intelligent-Tiering strategy, lifecycle and retention policies, noncurrent versions and incomplete uploads, and request costs, using Storage Lens and inventory data
  • Take every recommendation to closed-loop automation with guardrails, progressive rollout, and rollback, in partnership with the Storage infrastructure team, handling constraints such as AWS capacity shortages, fallback instance types, and connection pooling
  • Measure outcomes in cost and reliability (savings against baseline, forecast error, utilization, capacity left behind after events) and share our forecasts with the pod rightsizing system so compute and storage scale together

What you bring

  • Deep hands-on experience operating AWS storage and databases at scale, especially Aurora or RDS (MySQL or PostgreSQL) and S3, including replication, read scaling, storage classes, and lifecycle management
  • Capacity planning and forecasting experience: modeling time-series demand, load testing, and translating traffic into instance counts, sizes, and storage growth
  • A track record of rightsizing infrastructure from utilization data (CPU, memory, IOPS, throughput, bytes stored) without hurting latency or availability
  • Strong Python or Go engineering, with experience building automation that safely modifies production infrastructure (guardrails, progressive rollout, and rollback built in), not just systems that observe and report
  • Familiarity with AWS storage and database pricing (S3 storage classes and requests, Aurora I/O-Optimized vs. Standard, Reserved Instances) is a strong plus
  • Experience with bursty, event-driven workloads (trading, payments, ticketing) or with Spark, Airflow, or Kubernetes is a plus

From enterprise LLM integrations to agentic workflows and hybrid cloud infrastructure, we're creating the foundation that supports how Robinhood leverages AI internally.

As a Senior AI Operations Engineer, Enterprise Tech, you'll play a key role in building, operating, and improving the infrastructure behind Robinhood's enterprise AI capabilities. You'll work across AI platforms, LLM integrations, automation, and production infrastructure, serving as a technical expert for complex challenges while partnering directly with developers and internal teams. This is an opportunity to help shape a growing function, solve emerging problems in AI operations, and build the systems and tooling that enable AI adoption across Robinhood.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA, New York, NY, and Bellevue, WA offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

What you’ll do

  • Build internal tooling, automation, and self-service solutions that streamline AI operations, reduce manual intervention, and improve the developer experience.
  • Own complex technical troubleshooting and escalations across AI platforms, working directly with developers and internal teams to resolve issues involving LLM integrations, model behavior, APIs, and system performance.
  • Manage and optimize enterprise integrations with LLM providers, including Anthropic Claude and Google Gemini, focusing on performance, token utilization, reliability, and cost efficiency.
  • Develop and improve observability, monitoring, and deployment pipelines for AI workloads, tracking metrics such as inference latency, API costs, token usage, and error rates.
  • Support and optimize agentic workflows, orchestration layers, vector databases, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems to improve reliability and scalability.
  • Partner with Product, Software Engineering, Business Systems, and AI Strategy teams to identify recurring issues, incorporate user feedback, and drive long-term improvements to enterprise AI capabilities.

What you bring

  • 5+ years of experience in IT Operations, Site Reliability Engineering, or AI infrastructure and support, with a track record of operating complex production systems.
  • Hands-on experience with enterprise AI platforms and LLM integrations, particularly Anthropic Claude and Google Gemini, including API integrations, prompt operations, and token management.
  • Strong Linux administration skills and proficiency in scripting and automation using Python, Bash, or similar languages.
  • Experience with infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and orchestration tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Chef, or Kubernetes.
  • Strong understanding of production infrastructure, system reliability, monitoring, and troubleshooting across cloud or on-premises environments.
  • Ability to independently investigate ambiguous technical problems, identify root causes, and develop scalable solutions that prevent recurring issues.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience partnering directly with developers and cross-functional teams to resolve technical challenges.
  • Bonus: Experience with GPU clusters, AI workload orchestration (Slurm, Ray), vector databases (Pinecone, Milvus), AI frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex), or hybrid cloud and bare-metal infrastructure.
